hops.text: The bug: `get_or_create` resurrects dropped tables. Fix: check tombstones and raise instead of recreating. Editable path: warehouse/lifecycle.py only.

Fix get_or_create to raise RuntimeError if name in tombstones. Also, should create() be consistent? create already raises. The fix: in get_or_create, if name in tombstones, raise RuntimeError(f"dropped:{name}").
